text: Account registration. Как создать аккаунт или зарегистрироваться: open the sign-up screen, choose Create account, enter your email, create a password and confirm the email using the verification message.

Password reset. Как поменять пароль: open Settings > Security, choose Change password, confirm the current password and set a new one. If you forgot the current password, use Forgot password on the sign-in screen.
Email change. Как изменить email или почту: open Settings > Account > Email, enter the new address and confirm it using the verification message.
Subscription cancellation. Как отключить подписку: open Settings > Subscription and choose Cancel subscription. Access remains active until the end of the paid period.

Application troubleshooting. Если приложение не работает, падает или не загружается: update the app, restart it, check the network connection and retry. If the issue persists, send the app version and platform to support.
Notification settings. Как отключить уведомления: open Settings > Notifications and disable the required notification channels.
